usedFor: Each guest who books through Retime gets a deal in HubSpot.

bestTemplate.name: “New Event Booked” in Retime, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A booked meeting signals real interest, and “Create Deal” puts it in the pipeline.

watchOut: “New Event Booked” only sees events in the next 30 days, so later bookings wait.
